title: Kashmir Offbeat — Raw & Untouched Valleys
short_description: Venture beyond tourist hotspots into untouched paradise — Gurez Valley, Bungus meadows, and serene Doodhpathri.
description: Escape the crowded tourist paths with Noor-e-Jheel's exclusive Offbeat Kashmir expedition. Journey across Razdan Pass into the mystical border valley of Gurez, walk through the pristine pine meadows of Doodhpathri, and explore the hidden wilderness of Bungus Valley with local Kashmiri guides who know every secret trail.
highlights: Cross the dramatic 11,672 ft Razdan Pass with views of Harmukh peak
Stay alongside the turquoise Kishanganga River in Gurez Valley
Explore the untouched alpine pastures of Bungus Valley
Picnic in the lush green valleys of Doodhpathri (Valley of Milk)
Traditional Kashmiri Wazwan feast and Dal Lake shikara sunset

itinerary.title: Arrival in Srinagar & Sunset Shikara at Dal Lake
itinerary.description: Welcome to Srinagar! Our private chauffeur receives you at Srinagar Airport. Check in to a premium heritage houseboat on Dal Lake. Enjoy a relaxing 1-hour sunset Shikara ride across floating gardens and Char Chinar.

itinerary.title: Scenic Drive to Gurez Valley via Razdan Pass
itinerary.description: Depart early morning for Gurez Valley. Drive through Wular Lake shoreline, ascend the breathtaking Razdan Pass (11,672 ft), and descend into Dawar, the heart of Gurez, framed by the majestic Habba Khatoon peak.

itinerary.title: Habba Khatoon Spring & Border Villages Exploration
itinerary.description: Visit Habba Khatoon spring with crystal clear mountain water, explore traditional log-wood villages of Tulail and Chakwali (the last Indian village near LOC). Enjoy campfire under starry Himalayan skies.

itinerary.title: Gurez to Bungus Valley Wilderness Expedition
itinerary.description: Scenic drive down to Kupwara region to discover the hidden Bungus Valley — vast rolling meadows ringed by coniferous forest and gushing streams, completely pristine and tourist-free.

itinerary.title: Bungus to Doodhpathri — Valley of Milk
itinerary.description: Drive towards Doodhpathri, named for its foaming milky mountain river Shaliganga. Walk on lush carpet grass surrounded by dense deodar trees and snow-capped peaks.

itinerary.title: Old Srinagar Heritage Walk & Mughal Gardens
itinerary.description: Explore the historic Jamia Masjid, Shah-e-Hamdan wooden shrine, and Nishat Bagh & Shalimar Bagh gardens. Savor authentic Kashmiri Kehwa and dry fruit shopping in Lal Chowk.

itinerary.title: Departure from Srinagar Airport
itinerary.description: After a hearty Kashmiri breakfast, our chauffeur drops you at Srinagar Airport with lifelong memories of untouched paradise.

inclusions: 6 Nights accommodation (Houseboat + Gurez Riverside + Boutique Hotels)
Daily Buffet Breakfast and Gourmet Dinner
Private sanitized cab (Innova/Crysta) for the entire duration
All interstate tolls, parking, driver night charges, fuel
1-Hour Dal Lake Shikara ride with photoshoot stop
Inner-line permits and military check-post clearance support for Gurez
24/7 Dedicated Local Concierge assistance in Kashmir

faqs.question: Is Gurez Valley safe for families and couples?
faqs.answer: Yes, absolutely. Gurez is very peaceful and hospitable. Noor-e-Jheel manages all required army/civilian permissions and provides verified local drivers.

faqs.question: What is the best time to visit Gurez and Bungus?
faqs.answer: May through October is the ideal season when passes are clear and meadows are carpeted in green and wildflowers.
